value.rationale: The quotient of two consecutive-generator semigroups is a natural and studied arithmetic operation; residue distribution of gaps is independently motivated by Shor. The formula completely characterizes each class for arbitrarily large odd composite or prime quotient denominators, while the discrepancy bound 2 is independent of p and t and optimal for every odd p>=5. Both features go beyond genus or isolated numerical examples.
